get_norm_layer: get a normalization layer class from a config specifying batchnorm, sub_batchnorm, or sync_batchnorm type
create_subbatchnorm3d: create a SubBatchNorm3d layer that splits the batch dimension into N splits for independent BN computation
aggregate_subbatchnorm_stats: call aggregate_stats on a SubBatchNorm3d layer to synchronize running_mean and running_var before evaluation
use_groupgather: use GroupGather to perform all-gather of tensors across local process or GPU groups in distributed training
create_syncbatchnorm3d: create a NaiveSyncBatchNorm3d layer that synchronizes batch norm statistics across multiple GPU devices
